questions.question: Q: What is the choreographic intention of 'Within Her Eyes'?

points.text: To explore the emotional weight of a relationship — the woman is never placed on the floor, always supported, representing love, dependence and the burden of emotional connection.

questions.question: Q: Why are lifts the defining movement feature of this work?

points.text: Lifts physically embody the choreographic intention — the male supports the female throughout, making the idea of carrying emotional weight visible and tangible to the audience.

questions.question: Q: How does the costume contribute to the meaning of the work?

points.text: Everyday clothing makes the dancers relatable and the relationship believable — it suggests this could be any couple, not stylised theatrical characters.

questions.question: Q: Describe the role of the aural setting in 'Within Her Eyes'.

points.text: The soundscape of music and spoken text creates an intimate, emotional atmosphere that reinforces the themes of love, loss and memory, adding depth to the movement.

questions.question: Q: How does the narrative structure support the choreographic intention?

points.text: The narrative follows the emotional arc from connection to separation, allowing the audience to experience the relationship's journey and understand the weight of loss.
